name: Restore User Data After Move
description: Finds played state, resume positions, favourites and ratings that Jellyfin stranded when a media path changed, works out which current item each stranded snapshot belongs to, and restores it through Jellyfin's own user-data manager. Two scheduled tasks, neither of them triggered. The stranded rows are never modified or deleted.
overview: Recovers user data Jellyfin stranded when media paths changed
